changes: Fixes installed upgrades failing with DeleteFile failed; code 5 (Access is denied) when NewzDeckService.exe remains locked after the background service receives a stop request.
Replaces the installer's fixed 1.2-second wait after sc stop with the installed NewzDeckService.exe stop helper, which waits for the Windows service to reach STOPPED before Setup overlays files.
Makes service shutdown a fail-safe pre-install gate: if the installed helper is missing, elevation is denied, or the service cannot stop cleanly, Setup aborts before application files are replaced.

Adds a real locked-service upgrade smoke test using a deliberately slow-stopping NewzDeckService.exe so future release validation exercises the file-lock condition that caused the v3.6.0 upgrade regression.
Preserves the accepted v3.6.0 UI/UX Overhaul and all v3.5.x runtime, private SAB, Automation, Smart Import, Discover, provider, tray, and authoritative-runtime behavior.
regression_guards: v3.6.0 UI/UX Overhaul remains preserved without presentation changes.
v3.5.52 Authoritative Service Runtime Handoff remains preserved.
v3.5.51 BOM-safe provider loading remains preserved.
v3.5.49 Smooth Post-Processing Motion remains preserved.
v3.5.47 Session 0 SAB Launch Fix remains preserved.

Private SAB queue/history, Smart Import, Automation, Discover metadata behavior, tray/service runtime behavior, and Metadata Server v0.3.3 compatibility remain unchanged except for version identifiers and installer upgrade coordination.
